quest.title: Is This Novel Amazing?
quest.description: Shigeru, an editor at the Yae Publishing House, seems to be arguing with the writer Junkichi over some matter...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: In the chapter I'm working on, the main character is preparing for the next big fight.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: He needs a powerful weapon... Let me think...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Let's go check out the Amenoma Smithy.

talks.objective: Go to Amenoma Smithy with Junkichi

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Sparks fly as hammers clash against anvils...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Amenoma Smithy is such place full of passion!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Blacksmiths turn rough billets and ore into powerful weapons using such simple tools.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: If alchemy is used while forging, wouldn't it be possible to create indestructible weapons?

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Yes! That's a good idea. The main character shall have the strongest weapon! One forged using alchemy!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Now, this weapon needs to have an awesome name... and an awesome backstory.

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: That's it!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Traveler, let's go back. I'm going to tell Shigeru about my idea.

choices.text: I don't think you understand alchemy...

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: What do you mean? Isn't alchemy the kind of thing that makes the impossible possible?

talks.objective: Go to Tsukumomono Groceries with Junkichi

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Tsukumomono Groceries sells all kinds of goods similar to the items collected during my character's adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I mean, Aoi always says that "one man's trash is another man's treasure."

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Hmm... It seems like finding out what the buyer values is the key to selling goods at a high price.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: But if I write it like this, I'll have to spend time describing psychology. It doesn't fit the theme.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: ...Why don't I just make the main character a psychic that can intuit the needs of the buyer?

choices.text: You can't suddenly add traits to the character!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: It's character development. It's okay. Don't worry.

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Well, there we have it, then! I know what to write!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Traveler, let's go back. I'm going to tell Shigeru about my idea.

choices.text: Where's its basis in the plot?

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Plot basis... hmm, I'll think about it while I write. It shouldn't be a problem.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: The Doushin keep the peace in Hanamizaka. No criminals can escape their watch.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: In the story, the enemy's knights have the same duties as the Doushin. But to make it interesting, let's make them ten times as strong.

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Number scales are the clearest thing in the world. That'll help us show how powerful the main character is!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Well, I'll... give the main character mastery over disguises. Like being able to freely change their appearance and voice.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is this some new character trait?...

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: This is the main character's hidden ability. An encounter with certain enemies is the best time to reveal it!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hey, you just made that up, right?

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: N—No... It was my plan all along. C—Come on, now!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Anyway, let's just go with that. Time to go tell Shigeru about my idea.

choices.text: And how will the main character solve this conundrum?...

talks.objective: Go back to the Yae Publishing House to find Shigeru

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: I hope this month's issue can be printed on time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, Junkichi's idea isn't bad...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Not bad? If he keeps going like this, he's going to confuse even himself.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you see? The Traveler's on my side. That means my idea is appealing!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: The most important thing in a novel is an exciting and attractive plot. I'm writing with that in mind.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: *sigh* You...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Come on, relax. I know what I'm doing. It will definitely get unanimous praise. You'll see.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Actually, Shigeru sounds more reasonable...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Reasonable? Reasonableness is no substitute for a good plot. A reasonable plot would be boring without a compelling story!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: You... mark my words, when it comes time to wrap up the story, you'll go crazy trying to tie up the loose ends!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I—I took some notes. We won't have any problems ending the story!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: You have to take notes to remember all the details, do you? Are you expecting the readers to take notes as well?

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Uh... Well...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: I'm not saying you can't add these new features. I'm just saying that you have to be mindful of how many there are and when they are added.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Writing a novel is like running a marathon. If you go too hard at the start, you'll just lose steam later on.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: The key to a successful novel is to move forward steadily, one step at a time. Trust me.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Okay, okay... *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Junkichi, the deadline to turn in the manuscript is tomorrow. No more delays!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: There's no use pushing me! I'm stuck at a critical point in the story and I've got writer's block.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two arguing about?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: ...Traveler! Just the voice of reason we need.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: I'm Shigeru, an editor at the Yae Publishing House. This is Junkichi, the writer I'm in charge of.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: His new novel, "Onibudo," is very popular. But he never meets his deadlines. Sometimes he even delays for weeks.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: And he's at it again, of course. If he doesn't turn his manuscript in by tomorrow, I won't be able to get this month's issue into print.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Why don't we postpone the issue? Our loyal readers will still pay for it.

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Don't be ridiculous. If it isn't updated regularly, the novel's reputation will go into the trash!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: But I've just got no inspiration right now, and I'm not going to write some garbage chapter. There's just got to be an interesting story!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: But all the other writers are basically done. You're the only one left!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe Junkichi really just needs a bit of inspiration...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: That's right! My friend here gets me. I need inspiration!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I'll go around and look for some — I'm sure something will come to me!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Hey! That's the excuse you used last time to put it off. We're not doing this again!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I'm not lying this time. Come on, trust me just this once!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Hmm... All right. Fine. But this is the last time...

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: No further delays! Got it?

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Okay, okay, I got it...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Phew... I guess I can't put it off this time...

choices.text: Well, time to go get some inspiration then.

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Were it so easy...

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: But we have to do it somehow, or Shigeru will turn my house upside down...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: In the chapter I'm working on, the main character is trying to sell the items he collected during his adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: That will involve dealing with different types of buyers...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Hmm... Then let's go to Tsukumomono Groceries.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: In the chapter I'm working on, the main character sets off alone into enemy territory.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Gathering information is crucial to fighting the enemy. How should I write this...

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Hmm... let's go check out the Doushin at work.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: I found inspiration at Amenoma Smithy!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Really? Huh. You actually did it. Well, wonderful. Tell me about it!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: One night, the main character is suddenly enlightened, obtaining the superb alchemy ability — Sword Resurrection.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: He can transform a rusty blade into a powerful weapon simply by saying its new name!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: Thus, he will... Wait, what's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Hey... you're doing it again, aren't you!?

response.speaker: Shigeru
response.text: Let me guess. You're going to add new character traits to continue the story.

response.speaker: Shigeru
response.text: And you'll be tacking more complicated features onto those traits until you finish the new chapter, right?

response.speaker: Shigeru
response.text: No matter how much you like the character, stop giving him so many skills! The readers are going to get confused!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: That's always been my style. I think it's interesting. The readers will love it!

response.speaker: Shigeru
response.text: Don't give me that. You know the readers are starting to get confused by everything you make up!

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Ugh, I'm done talking to you. You're so boring. Let's hear the Traveler's opinion.

response.speaker: Junkichi
response.text: Traveler, who do you think is right, me or Shigeru?

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: We visited Tsukumomono Groceries and I've had a plot breakthrough!

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Oh? That's great. Tell me about it!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: The main character suddenly awakens to a profound magic, the Third Eye of Perception.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: This allows him to see into the minds of others, so that he can maximize his trade profits.

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: In this way, it's... what's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Shigeru
dialogues.text: Oh? That's great. Tell me about it!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: The main character suddenly awakens to the use of disguises, allowing him to freely change his appearance and voice... Let's call it the Illusory Mirror!

dialogues.speaker: Junkichi
dialogues.text: This way, no matter how hard the enemy fights back, they can't stop the main character!
